record_type_quote: For the first attempt of replication, I attempted to run the provided do-file.

targets.title: School Desegregation and Urban Change: Evidence from City Boundaries.
targets.evidence_quote: Coded claim 4 text (original paper): “The difference-in-differences estimator indicates that the suburban price premium increased by an additional 5.8 percentage points in metropolitan areas where the central city was required to desegregate over the 1970s (column 3; ‘delta 1970–1980’ row: coefficient = -0.058; SE clustered by school district = 0.028; Significant at the 5 percent level.).”
targets.outcome_computational_quote:
Reproduction outcome: Based on these criteria, the claim did not reproduce.
Discussion: The reproduction coefficients are not exactly the same as in the paper, but are close. In hindsight, while the claim is not precisely reproduced, it can be relatively safely assumed that the author’s result is robust to reproduction.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: Analysis pipeline: “replication_do_file.do” is a Stata do-file to conduct the replication. All the analysis can be performed from this file. It is a slightly modified version of the original do-file (“deseg_results_aej.do”).
targets.outcome_reasoning: Comparable output was obtained, but the focal coefficient and sample size differed and the analyst explicitly judged the claim not precisely reproduced. The report describes only rerunning the original pipeline with path fixes. Its phrase robust to reproduction concerns numerical closeness, not tested alternative specifications.

reasoning: Completed original-data and code reproduction with one target. The assigned DOI node and report match the author group, target and file URL; project title has been expanded but identifies the same work.
